_comment: HARD publishing limits set by the owner (PR #1, 2026-11-22). Any scheduling code or agent must refuse to exceed these. Nothing is published without the owner's explicit go-live for an identified channel.
rules: Extra finished cities wait in the backlog; one city per day.
Livestreams are additional and need their own authorisation; they never replace or add to the three regular uploads.
Only the owner's LofiTrain channels, once connected and named by the owner. Never an unrelated account.
TikTok is deferred: zero TikTok posts until the owner re-enables it. The two vertical clips per city are YouTube Shorts.

No AI label on videos and no mention of AI in titles or descriptions (owner decision 2026-11-22, standing until the owner changes it). Descriptions say the artwork is illustrated and not real footage.
Every description has, in order: a one or two sentence description of that video, the channel blurb, the 'illustrated, not real footage' line, the music credit, hashtags.
